title: How Much Fiber in Green Beans? 4g per Cup
description: Green Beans: about 4 g of fiber per 1 cup, cooked (14% DV), from USDA FoodData Central. Portion table, comparisons, free calculator.
h1: How much fiber is in green beans?

answer.note: USDA FoodData Central, Beans, snap, green, cooked, boiled, drained, without salt

intro: Green beans rank #7 of 10 vegetables on this site for fiber per serving. Every figure below is scaled from USDA FoodData Central, the same data the calculator uses.

dataTable.caption: Fiber in green beans by portion
dataTable.note: Fiber and calories are scaled from USDA FoodData Central per-100 g values (rows listed under Sources). % Daily Value uses the 28 g reference on U.S. Nutrition Facts labels. Brands, ripeness, and cooking change real values.

sections.heading: How much fiber is in green beans?
paragraphs: USDA FoodData Central lists beans, snap, green, cooked, boiled, drained, without salt at 3.2 g of fiber per 100 g. One serving (1 cup, cooked; 125 g) therefore has about 4 g of fiber and 44 calories. That is 14% of the 28 g Daily Value on U.S. Nutrition Facts labels, or 16% of a 25 g day and 11% of a 38 g day.
Green beans are immature bean pods, so they are much lower in fiber than dried beans, but they are a solid everyday vegetable side with about 4 g per cooked cup.

sections.heading: Fresh, frozen, or canned
paragraphs: Frozen green beans are close to fresh for fiber. Canned green beans are softer and salted; rinse them and the fiber per cup is in a similar range.
Green bean casserole is mostly soup and fried onions, so the green beans themselves are a smaller share of each scoop.

sections.heading: How green beans compare with other vegetables
paragraphs: Of the 10 vegetables on this site, green beans rank #7 for fiber per typical serving and #5 for fiber per calorie. That works out to 9.1 g of fiber per 100 calories, a high ratio: you get a lot of fiber for the calories.

Close neighbors by serving: [Brussels sprouts](/fiber-in-brussels-sprouts) at 4.1 g (1 cup, cooked); [baked potato](/fiber-in-potato) at 3.8 g (1 medium, baked, flesh and skin); [sweet potato](/fiber-in-sweet-potato) at 3.8 g (1 medium, baked (flesh)). Across all 50 foods in the [fiber-in-foods table](/fiber-in-foods), green beans are #8 for fiber per calorie.

sections.heading: Adding green beans to your day
paragraphs: Steam or roast a cup as a side, or toss into a stir-fry with brown rice.

Example: 1 cup green beans, 1 baked potato, 1 cup broccoli. Using the same USDA values as the calculator, that comes to about 12.9 g of fiber, with 4 g from the green beans. Adjust the amounts in the calculator to match your plate.

faqs.q: How much fiber is in 100 g of green beans?
faqs.a: 3.2 g, according to USDA FoodData Central (Beans, snap, green, cooked, boiled, drained, without salt). That is the figure every portion on this page is scaled from.

faqs.q: How much fiber is in green beans (1/2 cup, cooked)?
faqs.a: About 2 g, for 62.5 g. Weigh your portion or edit grams in the calculator for a closer estimate.
Botanically yes, but nutritionally they are treated as a vegetable because you eat the immature pod.
Kidney beans are dried mature seeds and far higher: about 11.3 g (1 cup, cooked).
